text: Based on the data from NASA FIRMS active fire detections, there were no fire detections intersecting with the asset during the period from October 6, 2026, to November 5, 2026. The asset was fully covered by all sensors (VIIRS_SNPP, VIIRS_NOAA20, VIIRS_NOAA21, and MODIS) throughout this period. Therefore, it can be certified that no fire occurred on this asset during the specified period.
